notes.title: Update 6 is now live
notes.content:
Greetings,

Update 6 is now live for Art Spotting Co-op.
It includes:

9 new stages
9 new music

Note: Anyone who has previously completed the game should see the arrow to go to the next page upon loading the game.

The version is now v1.6 (It can be seen at the bottom left corner of the title screen once updated)


Thanks for reading, have a nice day.
